cases.note: AUTHORED (NE-31j): a call during a spoken bridge between two segments. The bridge is paused with the call (never left talking, never skipped), should-resume continues that same utterance, and its finished takes the Foray to the next real item — the segment after the bridge, at its in-point. JS reading of the plan's 'a call during a bridge resumes on the next real item': the resume lands in the bridge (L-05: a spoken line continues after a call) and the next real item follows it.
